The main takeaway from our work is that
automated 3-D tracing of neurons can be performed reliably on confocal and brightfield images, even in the case of incomplete dye filling, with the help of semiautomatic reconnection of dendrites.

3-D skeletonizing is possible even for images with high levels of noise and artifacts, and that the skeletonization can be used to generate a graph representation of the dendritic structure that is amenable to further analysis.
3-D image analysis methods are mature enough for routine use in neuroscience, and the results are comparable to manual tracing methods.
